event_records.description: Wanjiru Kamau receives the offer from Kestrel Analytics with a one-week deadline.

wanjiru_kamau.name: Wanjiru Kamau
wanjiru_kamau.persona_brief:
You are Wanjiru Kamau.
Wanjiru has received a data-engineer offer from Kestrel Analytics with a one-week deadline. She is currently employed in telecom, earning less than the offer's 15% raise. She is tired of shift-adjacent support work. Her partner is midway through a nursing program in Nairobi, and she values stability and proximity to support her partner. She must decide whether to accept the offer before the deadline.

kestrel_analytics.name: Kestrel Analytics
kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics.
Kestrel Analytics extended a data-engineer offer to Wanjiru Kamau on Monday with a one-week deadline. They await her definitive answer before the deadline passes.

resolution.question: Kestrel Analytics extended a data-engineer offer to Wanjiru Kamau on Monday with a one-week deadline. Will she give Kestrel a definitive answer before the deadline passes?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Wanjiru Kamau communicated a definitive acceptance or rejection to Kestrel Analytics before 2026-08-10T17:00:00+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
